findings.title: Error events are paired with the wrong IDs when nodestore returns partial results
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids and then zips error_ids with events.values(). nodestore.backend.get_multi omits missing node IDs, so when any event is absent, every later event payload shifts and is paired with the previous error_id. The returned ErrorEvent dicts then carry the wrong id (and any later consumer of that id gets incorrect data). Iterate over the returned mapping and match by node id, or fetch each id individually.

findings.title: Browser report validation permits reports with neither timestamp nor age
findings.body: BrowserReportSerializer makes timestamp and age optional and only checks the other field via truthiness. A report containing both age and timestamp passes when one value is 0, and a report containing neither is accepted at all. The Reporting API requires one of the two on a report; add an object-level validator requiring exactly one and check key presence rather than truthiness.

findings.title: Table widget renders an empty table when new visualization flag is enabled
findings.body: In the table branch, when organization.features includes 'use-table-widget-visualization', the code renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns={[]} and tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}}. It ignores result.data, result.meta, fields, title, loading state, and dataset custom renderers, so any org in the rollout sees a blank table instead of its widget data. Feed the actual result/meta/fields into the new visualization or keep the old table until it is wired up.

findings.title: Attribute-keys query cache is not scoped to organization
findings.body: The request URL is /organizations/${organization.slug}/trace-items/attributes/, but the React Query key is only ['use-trace-item-attribute-keys', queryOptions]. queryOptions contains project IDs and trace type but not the organization slug, so a cache entry created for one organization can be reused after the organization changes (especially when the project selection is empty), showing another org's attribute keys. Include organization.slug or the full org-scoped URL in the query key.
